consequence.statement: If the `experimental.http3` option remains in the static configuration, it is unsupported and prevents Traefik from starting.
consequence.remediation: Remove the `http3` option from the experimental section of the static configuration.

assertion.statement: The `experimental.http3` static configuration option is removed in v3; leaving it set is unsupported and prevents Traefik from starting.
